content: Randomized controlled trials have been conducted to compare the effects of intensive versus standard hypertension treatment strategies. According to Table 10.6 from the American Diabetes Association (ADA), one of the interventions studied in these trials involved the use of a single-pill combination therapy consisting of perindopril, an angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor, and indapamide, a thiazide-like diuretic.
